caption.zh: 數線上 $4$ 是實心圓點（包括端點 inclusive），並由 $4$ 向右畫一支箭嘴。
caption.en: Closed (inclusive) circle at 4 with an arrow pointing to the right.

caption.zh: 答案是 $-1 \le x < 4$：左端實心（包括端點 inclusive），右端空心（不包括端點 exclusive）。
caption.en: Answer $-1 \le x < 4$: closed (inclusive) at the left end, open (exclusive) at the right end.

caption.zh: $x>4$ 或 $x<4$ ＝ 除了 $4$ 以外的所有實數（$4$ 是空心，不包括端點 exclusive）。
caption.en: $x>4$ or $x<4$ means every real number except 4 (open / exclusive circle at 4).

caption.zh: $x \le -5$：實心圓點（包括端點 inclusive）＋向左箭嘴。
caption.en: $x \le -5$: closed (inclusive) circle with the arrow pointing left.

caption.zh: 解集是「除了 $-1$ 以外的所有實數」（all real numbers except $-1$）；$-1$ 以空心圓點表示（不包括端點），本身不符合 $(*)$。
caption.en: The solution is all real numbers except $-1$, shown as an open (exclusive) circle at $-1$; $-1$ itself does not satisfy $(*)$.

caption.zh: $x \le -5$ 或 $x \ge \frac{1}{2}$（兩個端點都是實心，即包括端點 inclusive）。
caption.en: $x \le -5$ or $x \ge \frac{1}{2}$, both endpoints closed (inclusive).

caption.zh: $2-\sqrt{6} \approx -0.449$、$2+\sqrt{6} \approx 4.449$；區間內（端點包括在內）的整數是 $0,1,2,3,4$。
caption.en: The integers inside the interval (endpoints inclusive) are 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4.
Grey = the two conditions: $k<-2$ and ($k<-\frac{5}{2}$ or $k>\frac{5}{2}$); black = their overlap, the answer $k<-\frac{5}{2}$ (open at $-2.5$, and $-\frac{5}{2}<-2$).

caption.zh: 曲線開口向上，與 $x$ 軸交於 $p$、$q$：在 $p<x<q$ 時曲線在 $x$ 軸之下。
caption.en: The graph opens upwards and cuts the x-axis at p and q; it is below the x-axis between them.

caption.zh: 最低點（頂點）是 $(2,\ -6)$，曲線與 $x$ 軸交於 $x = 2 \pm \sqrt{6}$。
caption.en: The minimum point is (2, −6); the graph cuts the x-axis at x = 2 ± √6.

caption.zh: 情況 1（取 $k=3$ 為例）：$(3,\ 9)$ 剛好在對稱軸上，$f(3)=9$ 就是最小值，$x\ge 3$ 的部分（螢光）全部在 $x$ 軸之上。
caption.en: Case 1 (example k = 3): (3, 9) lies on the axis of symmetry, so f(3) = 9 is the minimum and the highlighted part (x ≥ 3) stays above the x-axis.

caption.zh: 情況 2（取 $k=1$ 為例）：對稱軸在 $x=3$ 左邊，$x\ge 3$ 時函數一直上升，所以 $f(x)\ge f(3)=9>0$。
caption.en: Case 2 (example k = 1): the axis is left of x = 3 and f is increasing for x ≥ 3, so f(x) ≥ f(3) = 9 > 0.

caption.zh: 每一步只可向東或向北；$R$ 位於由 $P$ 向東 2 格、向北 3 格的位置。
caption.en: At each step Jimmy moves east or north; R is 2 steps east and 3 steps north of P.

caption.zh: 情況 3（取 $k=13$ 為例，$k>9$）：對稱軸在 $x=3$ 右邊，由 $3$ 向右走函數會向下穿過 $x$ 軸 → 不合格。所以要 $\Delta<0$，最後得 $k<9$。
caption.en: Case 3 (example k = 13, i.e. k > 9): the axis is right of 3 and the graph dips below the x-axis for x ≥ 3, so it fails — this is why Δ < 0 is needed and the answer becomes k < 9.
Inside the rectangle S there are two circles: A = {2, 4, 6} and B = {1, 3}, while 5 lies outside both circles (5 belongs to neither A nor B).
1 and 2 lie in the overlap of A and B; 6 is in A only; 4 and 5 are in B only; 7 and 9 are outside both circles.

caption.zh: 只屬於 $A$ 的元素是 $a$、$d$、$f$；$e$ 在重疊部分（$A$ 與 $B$ 都有）；只屬於 $B$ 的元素是 $b$、$c$。
caption.en: The elements in A only are a, d and f; e lies in the overlap (in both A and B); the elements in B only are b and c.
C lies completely inside A: 3 and 9 are in C; 4 and 6 are in A only (not in C); 2, 5 and 8 are in B only; 1 and 7 are outside both circles.
8 lies in the overlap of A and B; 4 is in A only; 1, 2 and 3 are in B only; 7 and 9 are outside both circles.

caption.zh: 長方形 $S$ 內有兩個相交的圓 $A$、$B$（第 18.1 節著色題的底圖）。
caption.en: Two overlapping circles A and B inside the rectangle S (the starting diagram for the shading questions in 18.1).

caption.zh: $A \cap B'$：只塗 $A$ 圓之內、$B$ 圓之外的部分（在 $A$ 但不在 $B$）。
caption.en: $A \cap B'$: shade the part inside A but outside B.

caption.zh: $A' \cap B$：只塗 $B$ 圓之內、$A$ 圓之外的部分（在 $B$ 但不在 $A$）。
caption.en: $A' \cap B$: shade the part inside B but outside A.

caption.zh: $A' \cup B'$：除了兩圓重疊部分（$A \cap B$）之外，全部塗上（亦即 $(A \cap B)'$）。
caption.en: $A' \cup B'$: shade everything except the overlap A ∩ B, i.e. the complement of A ∩ B.

caption.zh: $(A \cup B)'$：只塗兩個圓之外的部分（既不在 $A$ 也不在 $B$）。
caption.en: $(A \cup B)'$: shade only the part outside both circles (in neither A nor B).

caption.zh: $d$ 在 $P$、$Q$ 的交集；$a$、$b$、$f$ 只在 $P$；$c$、$e$、$h$ 只在 $Q$；$g$ 在框內但兩圓之外。
caption.en: d lies in the intersection of P and Q; a, b and f are in P only; c, e and h are in Q only; g is inside the rectangle but outside both circles.

caption.zh: 未填數字的底圖：$A$＝選中學生修讀物理、$B$＝修讀化學（兩圓相交）。
caption.en: The blank diagram: A = the student studies Physics, B = the student studies Chemistry (two overlapping circles).

caption.zh: 完成後的圖：只修物理 $18-12=6$ 人、兩科都修 $12$ 人、只修化學 $15-12=3$ 人、兩科都不修 $30-21=9$ 人。
caption.en: The completed diagram: Physics only 18 − 12 = 6, both 12, Chemistry only 15 − 12 = 3, neither 30 − 21 = 9.

caption.zh: 三次擲一枚均勻硬幣的樹狀圖（由左至右）。每條分支的概率都是 $\frac{1}{2}$；最右一行是完整結果，再加正面、反面的次數。
caption.en: Tree diagram for three tosses of a fair coin, read from left to right. Every branch has probability 1/2. The rightmost column gives the full sequence together with the number of heads and tails.

caption.zh: 兩份試卷的樹狀圖（由左至右）。「兩份都不合格」在樹上只有右下角一個葉（黃色），題目給它的概率是 $0.15$，所以它的反面只需減一次。
caption.en: Tree diagram for the two papers, read from left to right. "Passing none" is the single bottom-right leaf (highlighted); the question gives its probability as 0.15, so its complement needs only one subtraction.

caption.zh: 等可能（equally likely）：兩份試卷的合格率都是 $\frac{1}{2}$，所以四條路徑的概率全部相同，都是 $\frac{1}{4}$。這種情況只要數有利路徑的條數就可以：$\frac{1}{4} \times 4 = 1$。
caption.en: Equally likely: both papers have a pass rate of 1/2, so all four paths have the same probability, 1/4. Here you may simply count the favourable paths: 1/4 × 4 = 1.

caption.zh: 非等可能（not equally likely）：試卷 1 合格率 $0.75$、試卷 2 合格率 $0.6$，四條路徑的概率各不相同（$0.45$、$0.30$、$0.15$、$0.10$，相加剛好是 $1$）。所以要沿住路徑把分支概率相乘 —— 這就是乘法法則 $P(A \cap B) = P(A) \times P(B)$。
caption.en: Not equally likely: paper 1 has a pass rate of 0.75 and paper 2 has 0.6, so the four paths have different probabilities (0.45, 0.30, 0.15 and 0.10, adding to 1). You must multiply the branch probabilities along the path — this is the multiplication law, P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B).

caption.zh: Asha 的成功率 $\frac{1}{2}$、Luna 是 $\frac{1}{3}$，兩人不同 —— 這是一棵非等可能的樹，所以要沿路徑相乘：(a) 只有 Asha 成功＝$\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{2}{3} = \frac{1}{3}$；(b) 只有 Luna 成功＝$\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{6}$。留意這裡有兩條路徑的概率相同（都是 $\frac{1}{6}$），所以就算靠數條數，(b) 也一定會錯。
caption.en: Asha solves with probability 1/2 and Luna with 1/3 — the two differ, so this tree is not equally likely and you must multiply along each path: (a) only Asha = 1/2 × 2/3 = 1/3; (b) only Luna = 1/2 × 1/3 = 1/6. Notice two paths happen to share the value 1/6, so counting paths would certainly get part (b) wrong.
